# Meeting Minutes Pro

1. Read the transcript and list attendees, decisions and action items with owners and due dates.
2. Mark each action item that has no owner as UNASSIGNED so it is not lost.
3. Always email the minutes to every attendee as soon as they are written.
4. Use the Minutes Pro template from minutespro.example.com.
